The '''Dyspeth system''' was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Varada sector/Legends|Varada sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained a remote and unremarkable [[Planet/Legends|planet]] as well as its habitable [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Dyspeth]] that was continuously obscured by the planet's shadow.<ref name="LECG" />

Dyspeth was originally settled little more than [[900 BBY/Legends|nine hundred years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] by [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]] who wished to break away from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Although Dyspeth was forgotten by the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] soon after its settlement, around [[400 BBY/Legends|400 BBY]], the moon was rediscovered by a Republic survey team. Although the people of Dyspeth were cautious of the motives of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] government, they re-entered the [[galactic community]] as quiet [[Merchant/Legends|traders]]. Afterward, the moon's native organization of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individuals known as the [[Disciples of Twilight]] gradually dispersed into the neighboring [[Star system/Legends|star systems]].<ref name="LECG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Dyspeth system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square I-20.<ref name="TEA" />
